{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness gate - per-turn persistent-operation counter: remind, instruct the model to stop, then ask for confirmation. Steps aside under sandbox/read-only modes; follows a live permission switch without restart. Verified on real hardware (full -> workspace-write -> read-on","id":"gh:1423059076","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-confirm-gate","slug":"SteelUnion/dsh-confirm-gate","topics":["agent-safety","ai-agent","ai-governance","budget-control","confirm-gate","cost-control","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","guardrails","llm","nodejs","permission","permission-control","plugin","tool-use"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness gate - per-turn persistent-operation counter: remind, instruct the model to stop, t"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"hen ask for confirmation. Steps aside under sandbox/read-only modes; follows a live permission switc"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"h without restart. Verified on real hardware (full -> workspace-write -> read-on"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-confirm-gate"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> **Stops your AI agent before it rewrites 20 files and burns a day of budget.**
>
> Install it and "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"every action the model takes is counted. As the budget runs down it
> starts telling the model to br"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ake; at the hard limit the model stops and waits for you
> to type `confirm`. **No kernel changes, n"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"o required config.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 中文 · **v0.3.0**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What's new in v0.3.0"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The gate now stays active under sandbox modes too. Previously it stepped aside in
`read-only` and `w"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"orkspace-write`, on the reasoning that a sandbox already bounds what
the model can do. That reasonin"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"g covered *what* the model can touch, not *how many times*
it touches it: 40 file edits inside a wor"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"kspace-write session are still 40 edits, and
still worth a nudge before the 41st."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"So `SANDBOX_MANAGED_MODES` is now empty and the counter runs in every mode. The
counter, the three r"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"eminder tiers, and the `confirm` release are all unchanged. If you
relied on the old stepping-aside "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"behaviour, set `SANDBOX_MANAGED_MODES` back to
`['read-only', 'workspace-write']` in `lib/index.js`."},{"id":"p7s4","text":" Correctness fix only: the streaming
mode-detection path now reads the mode on each call rather than"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" caching it, so switching
permission modes mid-session follows immediately."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## What it looks like while running"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**It is not an interceptor; it is a counter that talks.** Every counted call comes with a message. T"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"he first 10 nudge the model to ask you;
11–14 escalate to an instruction to stop; only the 15th actu"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ally blocks the tool.
That gap is what lets the model come to a halt while you are away from the key"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"locks the tool.
That gap is what lets the model come to a halt while you are away from the keyboard."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## What it saves you"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Situation | Without it | With it |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| The model loops, rewriting the same file | Burns the whole budget | Warns from the 11th call, stop"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"s at the 15th |
| You step away for half an hour | You come back to 200 changed files | It stopped b"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"efore you got back |
| You want it to continue | No idea how far it got | Reply `confirm` and the wh"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ole turn is released |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**This is not a security sandbox** — sandboxing is DSH's own job. This manages **cost and
direction*"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"*: it gives the model the ability to brake before it burns money or drifts."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Trade-offs & known limitations"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Listed first, because they are the interesting part."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"1. **The first N operations have no gate at all.** In the default `freeLimit: 10` configuration, ope"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"rations 1–10 are allowed with only a reminder. That window is deliberate — it gives the model room t"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"o correct itself before being asked to stop. Set `freeLimit: 0` when you want zero tolerance; the pl"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ugin then ask-confirms before the very first persistent operation.
2. **`confirm` defends against ac"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"cidents, not injection.** The threat model is a *trusted user with a fallible model*, where the fail"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"ure to prevent is unbounded trial-and-error. Prompt injection is a different layer — that is what DS"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"H's approval channel and sandbox are for. Do not deploy this as the only thing between an untrusted "},{"id":"p17s8","text":"input and your filesystem.
3. **The release rule is deliberately coarse.** Any message containing th"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"e trigger word releases the entire turn, including a message that merely discusses the word. This is"},{"id":"p17s10","text":" on purpose: ambiguity is resolved by what the user typed, not by the plugin guessing intent.
4. **C"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"ommand judgement is a name comparison, not a parser.** `Get-ChildItem $p.GetFiles()` is counted as p"},{"id":"p17s12","text":"ersistent, because the plugin does not evaluate the pipeline. The error direction is chosen: over-co"},{"id":"p17s13","text":"unt, never under-count.
5. **A tool call is one count**, regardless of how many files it touches."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Why not X"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Alternative | Why not |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| **Hard-block instead of counting** | Tried first in an OpenClaw build. A wall turns every write in"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"to an interruption the user did not ask for. With a counter and an explicit stop instruction, the mo"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"del does the arithmetic itself — it stopped at 11/15 on its own. The brake works better than the wal"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"l. |
| **Plugin-only, no DSH host hooks** | The per-turn count has to come from the **tool-dispatch "},{"id":"p20s5","text":"layer**. A wrapper around the model API cannot see individual tool calls, so it cannot count them. T"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"he count lives where the calls live. |
| **Fold it into the sandbox** | Different question, differen"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"t layer. A sandbox answers "is this allowed?". This answers "how much has happened?". Sitting inside"},{"id":"p20s8","text":" the sandbox would tie a budget to a permission model that changes underneath it. |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## 3. What this framework lets you tune"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**Everything is configurable; nothing is hard-coded.** Configuration lives in the profile's `cordis."},{"id":"p22s2","text":"g is configurable; nothing is hard-coded.** Configuration lives in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## 4. What counts as a "persistent operation""},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The test: **after the action completes, has the outside world changed?**"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### What you will see"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Asking the model for options in a WeChat session returns:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"**That is not a crash — it is the guard working.** The model then rewrites the question as plain tex"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"That is not a crash — it is the guard working.** The model then rewrites the question as plain text."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### Limitations"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **Requires the channel plugin to provide the `wechatQueue` service.** Without it the guard degrade"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"s to not blocking, and this plugin will not error.
- **Only the service name `wechatQueue` is recogn"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ised.** Other channels (Slack, Discord, …) need their own same-named service, or a branch added here"},{"id":"p30s4","text":".
- **WeChat will never have clickable options.** That is an inherent cost of a turn-based channel, "},{"id":"p30s5","text":"not something this plugin can work around."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"### 10.6 What `exec` carries"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Fields this plugin actually uses from the `tools/pre-execute` `exec`:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| Field | Use |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| `exec.name` | Is this an interactive tool? |
